Karnataka Minister's Remarks Spark Speculation on Siddaramaiah's Role

Karnataka Minister Satish Jarkiholi's comments suggesting political advancement involves leaving others behind have fueled speculation about Chief Minister Siddaramaiah's position. Jarkiholi stated that such dynamics are common in politics. The remarks have been interpreted by some as indicating a potential sidelining of Siddaramaiah within the party.
